class.name: ServiceRegistry
class.description:
ServiceRegistry allows modules to register and discover services by name at runtime, without compile-time coupling. It replaces dynamic plugin loading for cross-platform compatibility.
Owned by [Application] — not a global singleton.
[b]Note:[/b] ServiceRegistry stores raw [Object] pointers. The caller is responsible for keeping the service object alive (prevent GC for [RefCounted] services by holding a reference in your script).

method.name: get_service
method.description: Returns the service registered under [param name], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_service_names
method.description: Returns the names of all registered services.

method.name: has_service
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a service with [param name] is registered.

method.name: register_service
method.description: Registers [param service] under [param name]. Replaces any existing registration.

method.name: unregister_service
method.description: Removes the service registered under [param name].
